profile.summary: A small consulting company based in Sierra Madre, California. It provides training, technical assistance and professional development to help organizations and public systems engage families and communities, using the Family Café approach and the Strengthening Families Protective Factors Framework.

sources.title: Alameda County Health Care Services Agency board agenda item, February 6, 2024
